name: Albillos (Spain)
description: Square flag of three horizontal stripes of green, yellow and red crossed by a blue wavy diagonal from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Albillos (trees and a tower on green and red).
history: Municipal flag of Albillos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: wavy diagonal from the upper hoist to the lower fly
